item.name: Get Corporate Actions Price Mergers and Acquisitions package view

request.name: Get Corporate Actions Price Mergers and Acquisitions package view

description.content:
The Corporate Actions – Price, Mergers and Acquisitions package provides data on dividends and other payments to shareholders, stock splits, rights issues, and spin offs, as well as mergers and acquisitions made by the issuing companies, and the adjustment factors relating to these corporate actions.

The package contains the following datasets:

  - Capital Repayment

  - Cash Dividend

  - Mergers and Acquisitions

  - Rights Issue

  - Spin Off

  - Stock Split

Time series data supported.

query.description:
Specifies the type of the value passed in the `id` parameter.
Morningstar Performance ID is the default identifer for the API. Use the Universe API to retrieve Performance IDs for investments in your entitled universe.
Base currency to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3‑character ISO 4217 currency codes.
Domicile to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.
Exchange country to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.
Exchange identifier to use for investment lookup.

(Required) Filters results by corporate actions type. Accepts:

  - `CD` = Cash dividend
  - `CR` = Capital repayment
  - `SC` = Special cash
  - `SD` = Stock dividend
  - `SP` = Spin off
  - `SS` = Stock split
  - `RI` = Rights issue

Filters results by event status.

  - `Completed` = Event completed
  - `Announced` = Event announced
  - `Approved` = Event approved
  - `Withdrawn` = Event withdrawn
  - `Terminated` = Event terminated
  - `Rejected` = Event rejected
  - `Postponed` = Event postponed
  - `Other` = Other status

Filters results by transaction type.

- `Offer` = Direct offer to shareholders.
- `Merger` = Combination of two companies to form a single new entity.
Time series start date. Accepts `yyyy-MM-dd`.
Time series end date. Accepts `yyyy-MM-dd`.
